changes.comment: BREAKING: Review: the Agent Runtime contract now settles submissions with provider-owned completion tokens: submit returns a RuntimeSubmission whose settlement resolves to an immutable RuntimeCompletion created at each real native result boundary, folded sends share one completion object, queued sends settle as distinct completions in provider order, stop without an observed final result settles as stopped without a completion, and providers report live assistant/tool activity through the submission's synchronous activity sink. Update every provider to create completion tokens at result boundaries and stop deriving settlement from per-send slots. No rebuild is required because these are provider and public TypeScript contract changes, not persisted Dreamux state migrations.
